settings_memories_help: Save preferences for your assistant. Only you can view and delete them.
settings_memory_limit: Up to 500 characters each and 200 memories. Private to your own-key assistant by default.
settings_memory_allow_site: Allow the site assistant to use this
settings_memory_site: Also available to the site assistant

agent_unknown_execution: The model call outcome is unconfirmed and its allowance remains reserved. Check again before regenerating.
agent_scope_change: Changing scope starts a new context.

agent_usage_warning: AI allowance is near its limit.

register_invite_malformed: That isn't a valid code format. It should be 16 letters and digits (like ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP).
register_username_hint: 3–20 lowercase letters, digits or underscores. Used for @mentions.
register_username_rule: The username must be 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
register_username_reserved: That username is reserved. Choose another.
register_username_taken: That username is taken. Choose another.
register_name_hint: 1–32 characters. It does not have to be unique; any language and emoji work.
register_name_rule: At most 32 characters, with no control characters.
register_name_reserved: That display name is reserved. Choose another.
register_password_unmet: The password doesn't meet the requirements below yet.
password_rule_simple: Not a repeated or sequential pattern
password_rule_identity: Doesn't contain your email name, username, display name or the product name
password_rule_common: Not a commonly used password (checked when you submit)
password_problem_too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
password_problem_too_long: The password can be at most 128 characters.
password_problem_too_common: That's a commonly used password. Choose another.
password_problem_too_simple: That password is too simple (repeated or sequential). Choose another.
password_problem_contains_identity: The password can't contain your email name, username, display name or the product name.
password_problem_generic: That password can't be used. Choose another.
verify_sent_text: We sent a verification email to {email}. The link works for one hour and only once. You can sign in after verifying.
verify_sent_note: Sending again invalidates the old link. Accounts not verified within 7 days are deleted.
verify_ask_text: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send it again.
verify_confirm_text: Press the button below to finish. This step needs you to confirm; a mail scanner opening the link doesn't use it up.
verify_invalid_text: It may have expired (it lasts an hour), been used already, or been replaced when you asked for a new email.
forgot_lead: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send a reset link.
forgot_sent_text: If this address has an account, you'll receive a reset email. The link works for one hour and only once.
forgot_sent_note: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder. For security we don't say whether the address has an account.
reset_lead: At least 10 characters, and not a commonly used password.
reset_effect: After the reset every device is signed out, and unfinished work started from those devices is cancelled.
reset_done_text: Every device has been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
reset_invalid_text: It may have expired (it lasts an hour) or been used. Ask for a new reset email.

shell_empty_text: Use the “＋” above to start a channel, a group or a direct message.

settings_theme_mode_help: Following the system switches between light and dark with it.
settings_accent_help: Bubbles, buttons and badges use a readable variant of each colour; every one is checked for 4.5:1 contrast.
settings_glass_help: Only the navigation layer uses glass; the message list is always solid.
settings_glass_system_off: The system has “Reduce transparency” on, so opaque is used.
settings_type_size_help: Makes everything larger or smaller, from −1 to +3 steps.
settings_reduce_motion_help: Every animation becomes a fade of at most 150 ms.
settings_sidebar_preview: Show message previews in the sidebar
settings_sidebar_preview_help: Turn off for a more compact sidebar.
settings_timeline_paged: Load messages page by page (screen reader mode)
settings_timeline_paged_help: Every loaded message is in the page and older ones come with a button instead of loading while you scroll. Suits screen readers.
settings_profile_email_help: Used to sign in and to reset your password.
settings_profile_username_hint: 3–20 lower-case letters, digits or underscores. You can change it once every 30 days.
settings_profile_username_warning: After you change your username you cannot change it again for 30 days. The old one stays reserved for you for 30 days.
settings_profile_username_invalid: Use 3–20 characters: lower-case letters, digits and underscores only.
settings_profile_username_reserved: That username is reserved and cannot be used.
settings_profile_username_cooldown: You can change your username once every 30 days. Next possible: {date}.
settings_profile_username_cooldown_soon: You changed your username recently; it can be changed once every 30 days.
settings_profile_name_reserved: That display name is reserved and cannot be used.
settings_profile_conflict: Your profile was just changed elsewhere and has been refreshed. Check it and save again.
settings_password_help: Changing it signs out your other devices.
settings_password_effect: After the change every other device is signed out, and unfinished work started from them is cancelled.
settings_password_changed: Password changed; your other devices were signed out
settings_passkey_help: Sign in with a fingerprint, your face or your device lock instead of a password.
settings_passkey_unsupported: This browser or device doesn't support passkeys.
settings_passkey_remove_text: This passkey can no longer be used to sign in. You can still sign in with your password.
settings_devices_privacy: Only you can see the IP address and browser; they are deleted when the session ends.
settings_devices_revoke_text: These devices are disconnected at once and have to sign in again.
settings_devices_revoke_all_text: Every device, including this one, is disconnected at once and has to sign in again.
settings_devices_revoke_effect: Assistant tasks and reminders started from these devices and not finished yet are cancelled, and are not restored.
settings_devices_signout_note: A normal sign-out does not cancel authorized tasks; only security actions such as signing a device out, changing or resetting the password, or a ban do.
settings_devices_revoked: Signed out; that device returns to the sign-in page within seconds
settings_timezone_mode: Time zone for chat and reminders
settings_timezone_mode_help: When fixed, chat times, “tomorrow morning” and reminder confirmations use this zone, and no other device overrides it.
settings_timezone_note: Daily limits reset on Asia/Shanghai time regardless of this setting. For times that do not exist or happen twice around daylight saving changes, you are asked to choose when you set a reminder.
settings_timezone_conflict: Your settings changed elsewhere. The latest are shown now; try again.
settings_sign_out_help: Signs out this device only. Assistant tasks and reminders you already authorized keep running.
invites_quota_admin: Administrators can create any number of invitation codes.
invites_uses_help: One use by default. Each registration with it takes one of your slots.
invites_note_help: Only you see it, to remember who it was for.
invites_created_once: The code is shown only now. After you leave you can revoke it but not see it again.
invites_created_link_help: The code comes after #, which is never sent to the server.
invites_created_note: Each registration with it takes one of your slots; the slot comes back if that account is cleaned up or revoked.
invites_revoked_toast: Revoked; the code can no longer be used
invites_registration_help: Registered {date}, email not verified. You see only the username, not the email address.
invites_registration_revoke_text: The account is deleted and the slot returns to you. If they already received the verification email, its link stops working.
